name: Datacenter national du Congo (Bacongo)
developer: Government of Congo / African Development Bank (AfDB); Sumec contractor
notes: National datacenter at former UAPT site, 2nd arrondissement Bacongo, Brazzaville; three levels + basement with server/control/supervision rooms and technical room for power/cooling; Tier III target; AfDB/CAB financing. As of 2025-08-06 works >90% complete with inauguration targeted before 28 Nov 2025 (state of nation); one low-grade aggregator (africahot.com, Dec 2025) reports inauguration on 28 Nov 2025, but no official/strong trade confirmation found as of check date, so kept at construction rather than operational. Grade A for project/financing, B for status.

name: ST Digital Brazzaville Datacenter
notes: Operator official page confirms Brazzaville datacenter: 'TIER III Datacenter compliant with international best practices', colocation (rack/half-rack), sovereign cloud, DRP/BCP, 24/7 monitoring and access control, local Brazzaville support. ST Digital positions itself as first neutral independent Tier 3 operator in Central/West Africa (sites: Douala, Abidjan, Libreville, Lome, Brazzaville, Kinshasa). Uptime certification not verified; capacity not published.

name: ARPCE Data Center Brazzaville (2021)
notes: DCD reports ARPCE previously built a datacenter in Brazzaville in 2021; Digital Business Africa states the Brazzaville ARPCE datacenter is Tier 2, housed in the ARPCE technical building, inaugurated before the Pointe-Noire one (28 Feb 2024). Keep separate from ST Digital and the AfDB Bacongo national DC per methodology dedupe rule (no address/operator evidence of merge).

name: E2C Data Center (Direction Generale de l'Energie)
notes: Utility data-storage centre located in the pavilion of the DG Energie building, Brazzaville; visited by energy minister Emile Ouosso on 12 Sep 2025; built since 2022, operates 24/24, one server room of approx. 82 sqm; serves E2C digitalisation/record preservation. Local press quoting named minister/DG (B+) but thin facility detail, graded C. Enterprise/utility facility, not commercial colocation.

name: ARPCE Data Center Pointe-Noire (Tier 3+)
notes: Tier 3+ datacenter in Pointe-Noire commissioned 28 Feb 2024 (government page: 'mise en service du Data center de type TIER 3+ construit par l'ARPCE'), reported 3.8bn FCFA / ~USD 6.3m; hosts CGIX-PN (2nd Congo IXP, launched 20 Sep 2024); DCD reports 54 racks / 156 sqm (capacity B/C until ARPCE datasheet). Official government source A for commissioning; capacity figures B/C.

name: Congo Telecom PNR1 carrier facility
notes: C-grade directory lead for a Congo Telecom carrier facility (PNR1) in Pointe-Noire near the cable/landing ecosystem. No Congo Telecom, ARPCE, PeeringDB or customer evidence confirming colocation/rack service found in this pass; remains lead-only until joined to primary sources.

name: Data center national secondaire - Oyo
notes: Secondary national datacenter planned at Oyo (Cuvette): Feb 2022 tender had separate lots for the main DC (Brazzaville) and the secondary DC (Oyo) with six companies bidding for Oyo lot (per Agence Ecofin). No public award/construction/operation evidence found in this pass; methodology treats third planned CGIX at Oyo as interconnection lead only. Do not upgrade without award/site/construction evidence.
